seo.title: About ODD — one platform, many ways in
seo.description: ODD brings creative expertise into wider use across culture, business and society, through events, spaces and programmes built in Helsinki.

panels.alt: Two people talking at a creative exhibition
panels.title: This is ODD.
panels.body: ODD brings creative expertise into wider use across culture, business and society — by building the structures that let creative professionals, organisations and communities meet, learn from each other and work together, again and again, not just once.

panels.alt: Motion-blurred crowd at an ODD event
panels.title: Finland has the creative talent. It doesn't have enough structure around it.
panels.body: Most creative work happens project by project — a show, a production, a grant cycle — and the relationships and momentum it builds tend to dissolve once it's over. Cross-disciplinary exchange stays occasional, and regular contact between creative professionals and other sectors is rarer than it should be. ODD exists to build the connective structures — events, spaces, programmes — that let that work and those relationships continue.

panels.eyebrow: One platform, different ways to participate
panels.title:
Creatives, communities, businesses,
institutions, partners, audiences.
panels.body: None of these groups sit on opposite sides of a table here. A festival organiser might also be an ODDspace member; a company at ODDference might end up commissioning ODDagency; a creative collective might become a Work with ODD partner. ODD is built for people to move between these roles, not stay fixed in one.

milestones.title: New Nordic Way rf founded
milestones.body: The non-profit behind ODD is founded in Helsinki to build stronger structures around Finland's creative economy.

milestones.title: Finding the gap
milestones.body: A year of research and concept work into what was actually missing for creative professionals in Finland, leading toward a shared, cross-sector gathering.

milestones.title: ODDfest pilots
milestones.body: The first ODDfest launches in Helsinki — around 2,600 participants, 350+ contributors and 70+ partners, reaching over a million people in total.

milestones.title: Creative Week, ODDference and ODDspace
milestones.body: ODDfest expands into a wider Creative Week, ODDference launches as a standalone flagship event, and the first ODDspace opens its doors in Vallila.

milestones.title: ODDfest opens up further
milestones.body: ODDfest continues as a distributed, open platform — the model Creative Week ran in 2026 — with year-round activity through ODDspace and ODDference continuing alongside it.

people.title: Who's behind ODD.
people.orgDescription: ODD is the public-facing platform operated by New Nordic Way rf, a Finnish non-profit founded to strengthen the structures around Finland's creative economy. New Nordic Way runs ODDfest, ODDference, ODDspace and the wider Work with ODD activity — ODD is the name you'll see; New Nordic Way rf is who's behind it.

network.title: Built with, not just for.
network.note: Built together with the partners, venues and institutions below — with more joining as ODD grows.

ambition.headline: A stronger place for creative work in Finland.
ambition.body: The longer ambition behind ODD is a Finland where creative work has better infrastructure, more continuity, and closer relationships with the rest of society — not because ODD builds all of that alone, but because events, spaces and programmes like these are practical, working parts of it.
